action.label: Action for every scan
action.hint: Chosen once, then applied to each barcode you scan.

reason.label: Reason (optional)
reason.hint: Stored with every action in this session, in the sample's chain of custody.

volume.label: Volume used
volume.hint: Subtracted from each sample you check in.

field.label: Scan a barcode
field.hint: The barcode is looked up exactly — a name is not enough to act on. The field stays ready for the next tube.
field.noLab: You are not a member of a lab yet, so there is nothing to scan into.

autoSubmit.label: Submit when the scan pauses
autoSubmit.hint: Off by default: most scanners send Enter. Turn this on only if yours does not.

session.newHint: Clears this log and lets the same barcodes be scanned again. It does not undo anything.

log.title: This session
log.emptyHint: Pick an action above, then scan the first barcode.

outcome.doneHint: Recorded in the sample's chain of custody.
outcome.notFoundHint: Nothing in this lab carries that barcode. Check the label, or look the tube up by name.
outcome.wrongStateHint: The sample is {{status}}, so {{action}} does not apply to it.
outcome.deniedHint: The server refused {{action}}: your role does not allow it in this lab. Ask a lab administrator.
outcome.duplicateHint: This session already applied {{action}} to this barcode, so the second scan was skipped. Start a new session to do it again.
outcome.ambiguousHint: More than one sample carries this barcode, so nothing was changed. Use Lookup to pick the right one.
outcome.unavailableHint: Nothing was changed, and the same scan can be sent again.

noUndo.title: There is no undo
noUndo.body: Every action is written to the sample's chain of custody, and the server decides what is allowed. This screen cannot take an action back.
noUndo.reverse: To reverse a check-out, scan the same tube again with Check in. A discard is final: nothing brings a discarded sample back, so a discard made in error is corrected by creating a new sample and recording why in the reason.
noUndo.session: Starting a new session clears the log; it does not undo anything.
